# Merit Ledger (功过格 / 功過格)

> Merit Ledger is a privacy-focused self-reflection and behavior-tracking application. It helps people record daily positive and negative actions, add notes or media, review history, and understand patterns through statistics.

Official website: https://official.meritledger.org/
Web application: https://web.meritledger.org/
Android application: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.meritledger.app
Contact: contact@meritledger.org

- English: https://official.meritledger.org/

- Japanese (功過格): https://official.meritledger.org/ja/
